summary: Spend geometric detail on the contour and meaningful part boundaries rather than distributing it evenly.
objective: The subject remains recognizable from multiple views, and simplification has not removed a handle, support or required joint.
intent_signals: Simplify polygons while retaining meaningful parts
example_prompts: Build a low-poly product viewer with simplified panels and a clearly modeled hinge.

principles: Spend geometric detail on the contour and meaningful part boundaries rather than distributing it evenly.
This is an authored creative proposal, not a historical definition, fixed template or required rendering library.
implementation: Use fewer, deliberately placed faces on broad masses; retain enough segments around turning joints and focal outlines to express their shapes.
Try a small palette with broad light separation; choose smooth or flat surface shading independently of polygon count.
Frame the strongest outline first, then orbit slowly to inspect corners; animate articulated groups instead of relying on dense surface deformation.
observable_checks: The subject remains recognizable from multiple views, and simplification has not removed a handle, support or required joint.
Inspect the selected view and an alternate view at the intended output size before accepting the treatment.

known_limits: Proposed art direction only; no rendered artifact, runtime improvement or perceptual validation has been observed for this record.
Appearance choices do not certify factual geometry, material measurements or simulated behavior.
creative_affordances: Combine with toon/cel shading, clay or painted finishes; low-poly does not require every surface to appear faceted.
Adapt this proposal to the explicit user brief; combine or depart from it while preserving any factual and interaction contracts.
